title.vi: Thông báo Ngân hàng (Miễn trừ theo Điều 4A (1) và (2)) 2004
title.th: ประกาศการธนาคาร (การยกเว้นตามมาตรา 4A (1) และ (2)) 2004

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Banking (Exemption from Section 4A (1) and (2)) Notification 2004 and shall come into operation on 7th July 2004.

2.—(1) The Authority hereby exempts Navy Federal Credit Union, an institution licensed and accredited under the laws of the United States of America, from —
(a)section 4A(1) of the Act, in respect of any deposit accepted in Singapore from any of its members in Singapore; and
(b)section 4A(2) of the Act, in respect of any offer or invitation —
(i)to make any deposit; or
(ii)to enter or offer to enter into any agreement to make any deposit,
in connection with the provision of services in Singapore by Navy Federal Credit Union for which it is licensed and accredited under the laws of the United States of America.
(2) The exemption is subject to such conditions as may be specified in letters issued from time to time by the Authority.
